metadata.rca: The Jira ticket documents a DMS car model animation issue for Toyota #2. The tester (Yuying Xing) verified the specified Kanzi build and marked the result as NG, listing 13 PC-side issues and 3 board-side issues. The animation reviewer (Bin Huang) found no additional new issues on PC. The core problems are animation timing/order mismatches, missing fade effects, incorrect highlight/sweep behavior, and inconsistent option box movement compared with the UI reference videos.
metadata.resolution: Need to fix the DMS car model animation to match the UI reference videos, including fade-in/out timing, element order, sweep duration, highlight behavior, option box movement, and mode-switch transitions. Then re-verify on both PC and board using the specified Kanzi build.
